lines.1: 「Leo, that's my bath towel. Even if you just washed your face, please don't dry it with that.」
lines.3: No wonder it smelled so nice.
lines.4: 「Is something bothering you? If so, you can talk to me.」
lines.7: 「As your sister, of course I worry when you seem down.」
lines.8: Hmm. If I told her I was thinking about my future, Otome would get all worked up.
lines.10: 「The truth is, sometimes I think about my parents being overseas for so long...」
lines.12: 「I am tempted to call you soft, but...」
lines.13: 「You are an only child, and your parents have been abroad for a long time now. I suppose you must get lonely...」
lines.15: 「But you have me. You are not alone.」
lines.16: Somehow, that genuinely made me feel better.
lines.17: 「Very well. Tonight, I will sit beside you and read until you fall asleep.」
lines.18: 「N-No, you don't need to go that far...」
lines.20: Otome sat on the edge of my bed and read as I lay there.
lines.21: Damn it. So this was how she'd get carried away.
lines.23: And here I thought it was a regular book, but she was reading a period drama.
lines.24: I would pretend to be asleep.
lines.29: Otome had said her dream was to be a martial artist, a childcare worker, or a teacher.
lines.30: I didn't know much about martial arts, but if she became a childcare worker or teacher, I was sure people would love her as a strict but kind instructor.
lines.31: ...What would I do with my life?
lines.32: As I thought about that, I began to feel genuinely sleepy.
